reviews.author: Kathleen OBrien
reviews.text: M&R just finished painting the exterior of our house. They did an excellent job, are very meticulous and pay attention to details. The painters are easy to work with and do terrific work. I recommend them highly.

reviews.author: Mark Liu
reviews.text: Marcos and Randi painted the outside of my house and it looks great! They were on time, professional and did a very thorough job. They also brought in a carpenter who repaired a lot of wood trim. Billing was very transparent with receipts for materials and labor broken down. I will bring them back in the future to do some more painting and powerwashing - highly recommended!

reviews.author: Albert Gerbig
reviews.text: M & R Painting recently painted the exterior of our home. We were extremely pleased with their attention to detail, meticulous work, respect for our property and punctuality. We would definitely hire them again.

reviews.author: sharon saatsoglou
reviews.text: M&R Painting Services transformed our house into a truly beautiful home. They are meticulous with such fine tuned attention to detail. They will work with you to select the right color that works best with your decor and the lighting specific to each room. I was particularly impressed with how well they protected all furniture and surfaces and how efficiently they put the rooms back together when the painting was complete. They are a pleasure to work with . Very professional I highly recommend M&R Painting

reviews.author: Margaret Schuler
reviews.text: I recently hired M and R Painting for the first time to do an exterior painting project and I can assure you it will not be the last. Although I was thoroughly impressed with Marco and Randi as professionals, the finished product was truly beyond my expectations. They were prompt, efficient and very pleasant. It was a pleasure dealing with them. Their attention to detail was exceptional and very evident in the finished product. I cannot speak highly enough about Marco and Randi’s skills and work ethic. I took a chance hiring them based solely on the reviews I read on the company’s website. That is why I felt compelled to write this review. If you are hesitant and not sure who to go with for a project I can absolutely assure you that you will not be disappointed with M and R Painting.

reviews.author: ALLY Torres
reviews.text: Where to start with the services M&R Painting has provided for me? Over the years, they've done interior and exterior painting jobs. Their attention to detail and the neatness in which they perform the work are astonishing. It is something that differentiates them from all other companies, just to start. You can also rest assured that you have very honest and hard-working individuals that will care for your home and treat it with respect. I just don't have anything bad to say about them other than praising them for doing an excellent job every time I've had the pleasure of hiring them. 100% recommended whether a job is small or big. They are one of the best, if not the best

reviews.author: Anna Zablocka
reviews.text: I recently had the pleasure of working with M&R Painting Services and I am thoroughly impressed with the exceptional service they provided. From the initial consultation to the completion of the project, the team exhibited a high level of professionalism and expertise. The painters were not only skilled and efficient but also meticulous in their attention to detail. The quality of work exceeded my expectations. I highly recommend this group for anyone seeking top-notch painting services with a focus on quality craftsmanship and customer satisfaction.

reviews.author: Stephen Lane
reviews.text: There is one word that describes the work done by Marcos, Randi and company (M&R Painting), EXCELLENT. They do prep the way it is supposed to be done, pay attention to the details, take pride in their work … and it shows. I originally hired M&R Painting to restore and paint my cedar siding salt box style colonial home. Since the previous painters improperly applied latex over oil-based paint, the paint on the entire house was peeling. Marcos and Randi started by stripping off all the old peeling paint using infrared heaters. Once this was completed (which took almost 3 weeks) they lightly sanded all the siding, applied one coat of oil-based primer, sanded again, then applied two-coats of latex-based paint. The results were fantastic, the house looks like new! In addition, Diego, who also doubles as a skilled carpenter, replaced a lot of the rotten trim boards and window stills, and did an outstanding job. Recently, I hired M&R back to paint three rooms in my house (living room, dining room and bedroom), plus the kitchen ceiling. They made sure to put down resin paper (with tape) and drop clothes to protect the floors, covered all the furniture with plastic, and walled off the rooms with plastic sheeting to keep the sanding dust from getting into other parts of the house. As with the exterior work, the crew arrived promptly at 8am and finished painting at 4pm, then proceeded to make sure everything was cleaned up and properly put away before they left the job at 4:30pm. Although painting interior spaces can be disruptive, Marcos and Randi did everything they could to minimize the intrusion. As a testament to their skill as painters, I was always surprised to see that they often wore black shoes and black pants to the painting jobs in the morning ... and left at the end of the day with not a drop of paint spilled on anything! M&R Painting gets my highest recommendation (5 out of 5 stars). They do high quality work at reasonable prices, are clean and neat, and are a pleasure to do business with. If you are especially interested in restoration work (historical or otherwise), these are definitely the guys for you.

reviews.author: Diane Zompa
reviews.text: I am delighted to comment on the outstanding exterior painting job provided me and my family by M & R Painting Services. We have an older clapboard home (about 130 years) with all of the problems associated with its age. Marcos and Randi approached the painting of our home with the attention and skills of art restorers. They schooled us in the importance of preparatory work leading up to the final coat of paint. Prior to engaging M & R, we had had our home painted a number of times and, within the first year or two, the paint began to peel noticeably and extensively in too many areas to count! We contracted with M & R to paint our home in sections over a four to five year span of time. They completed the final section - the front porch this fall. The sections painted five years ago look just as fresh and as perfect as the sections painted this fall - not even a touch up has been required! With M & R as our painters, we do not anticipate touching up or repainting our home sooner than 10 to 12 years out, maybe even longer! We were told that “you live with your painters” and we found that to be true. Marcos and Randi are truly a pleasure - hardworking, reliable and respectful of us and our home. We like them both!! And ... more importantly ... we love their work!! We would highly recommend them without reservations.

reviews.author: Dale Graff
reviews.text: M&R Painting Services did a wonderful job painting the interior of our home. The workmanship is excellent, they worked efficiently, professionally and made the extra effort to help keep our house clean and protect our floors and furniture. I would highly recommend them and look forward to working with them again on future projects we have in mind.

reviews.author: Alison Maclean
reviews.text: We have been working with Marcus and Randi for over 13 years. They have done extensive work on the interior and exterior of our 100 plus year old home. Their attention to detail is unlike any other painting company. They focus on outstanding prep work which ultimately gives you a high end long lasting paint job. At this point I believe they have painted nearly every room in the house. They have worked on restoration projects as well some of the new construction projects in our home. They leave their work site immaculate which is very refreshing. M snd R have worked on projects in our home when we’ve been away on travel. They are trustworthy and competent. They have always gotten the job right - in fact, just perfect. We will not use any other painting firm.

reviews.author: Edward Kimtis
reviews.text: M&R are professional and easy to work with. The do careful work returning walls to perfect condition before painting. They arrive on time, work quietly and keep a very clean work area. Their finished work is first class. We highly recommend M&R for your painting project.

reviews.author: Abigail Reynolds
reviews.text: M&R recently painted a bedroom in my old house (c. 1915) in Princeton. They did a wonderful job. Their care and attention to the prep of the old plaster walls and ceiling was impeccable. They also were meticulous with their drop cloths and taping, and cleaned up every last spec of dust when they were done. I can't speak highly enough of M&R and I will be hiring them again soon!

reviews.author: Ed Stier
reviews.text: We recently used M&R Painting Services to do extensive work on our severely water damaged home exterior and some work on the interior. We have never been so pleased with painting services. M&R is meticulous in their preparation of the surfaces they are working on. They are neat, covering areas around which they are working. Given the care they took painting our home, I expect it to last twice as long as any previous painting. In a word, they are “PERFECTIONISTS”. I recommend M&R without qualification. Ed Stier (Princeton, NJ)

reviews.author: Richard Scribner
reviews.text: M&R recently replaced the caulking around all our home’s casement windows and doorways and painted the soffits and trim. Marcos and team are exacting professionals, and all the work was of the highest quality and used the very best caulks and paints. Before painting, they power washed the soffits and fascia boards so they almost looked like they’d just been painted; they also washed off some discoloration on the north facing side of the house. All the windows were left paint free and washed! Everyone was very respectful of the house and adjacent plantings, and the site was carefully cleaned up at the end of each day’s work. I couldn’t praise M&R’s work more highly. Thanks, Marcos.

reviews.author: Steven Pieri
reviews.text: Marcos and Randi were amazing. We moved into a large 200 year old house and had so much to do. They treated and painted old paneling, took down really old wallpaper, smoothed the walls and painted and they helped paint many of the rooms. On top of the help they provided with the painting and preparing the house, they were extremely helpful and reliable. I was moving with my family from out of state and I entrusted them with helping collecting furniture shipments when I was traveling to get my family in California. In addition to everything above, they were extremely reasonable in cost. I wish I had more work for them right now, but I couldn’t recommend them more highly. I will absolutely use them again. Marco and Randi are the best.

reviews.author: Stephen Vincent
reviews.text: True professionals grounded in the details of a project, from basic prep to final coat. They see all the points the homeowner will see, let alone an intermittent guest. Very impressed with the results and the overall experience covering 4 main interior rooms simultaneously. High quality work from quality individuals that achieved our vision and transformed our space to a new level of expression. If you want perfection, M&R is your first and last choice.

reviews.author: Lynn Dulisse
reviews.text: The work was impeccable. Somewhat of a perfectionist myself, was thrilled at the beautiful job they did. Extremely professional, friendly, and didn't leave a drop of paint or clutter anywhere. Would highly, highly recommend them. If any future painting needs come up they would be the ones we call. It's extremely rare now days to have a company with this work ethic and pride in their work. Thanks Randi, Marcus and Crew!

reviews.author: Joa Roux
reviews.text: I enjoyed the tremendous pleasure of working with Marcos & Randy on an extensive (i.e. 1,800 work hour / 3 month long) restoration of the interior of my 18th century home during the spring of 2018. Everything about the project was complex, unexpected, and tight on time as we raced to finish before my first son was born. Their work was incredible and worth every penny. They are highly skilled craftsmen with an eye for detail and able to give excellent advice drawing from their deep breadth of experiences. No one should have any concerns whatsoever in vetting this top quality outfit - they are the best in the painting and restoration business in our area without question! I look forward to using their services again in the future and cannot recommend them more strongly.

reviews.author: Eileen Mccarthy
reviews.text: I have known Marcos and Randi for many years and many jobs. They are the most reliable painters you’re going to find. They will give you a very fair price, do a truly professional job with attention to detail that you won’t find with many painters. It’s actually a pleasure to have them in my home because they are kind and considerate and trustworthy in all ways. I’m always happy to recommend Marcos and Randi to friends and family!

reviews.author: Dennis Hanft
reviews.text: As a first time customer I can thankfully say we will use them again. Randi and Marcus are great guys! They take great care of your property and go above and beyond making sure their work meets or exceeds expectation. Effort is taken in ensuring a spotless cleanup.

reviews.author: JoAnn Markiewicz
reviews.text: We hav been using M&R painting for almost 20 years now and have been extremely happy with their work. Their work is meticulous and they are very professional. I have been recommending them through the years and everyone that has used them agrees that they are clearly the best in this area.

reviews.author: Bill Harley
reviews.text: Their work is superior to any I've seen The prep work is outstand and they are easy to work with. Their just very good, hard working guys. I definitely would hire them again.

reviews.author: Adam Jurin
reviews.text: These guys are absolutely amazing. My wife and I hired them to strip the wallpaper from the house we bought and to do paint on the new walls, and they were great at every step of the process. Communicated clearly and promptly, explained what they were doing and why they did it, worked quickly and efficiently, and the place looks amazing. I'd recommend them heartily to anyone.

reviews.author: Kevin Keener
reviews.text: Marcus and Randi did a phenomenal job with our daughters playroom. We were very happy with the outcome and will be using them again to do our son’s room. I would highly recommend Marcus and Randi to my friends or family. Thank you for doing a fantastic job!!

reviews.author: Lewis Arthur
reviews.text: Very professional and high quality workmanship, the team are responsive and immaculate in cleanliness. We have had the pleasure of working with M&R twice and will certainly retain their services in the future. 100% recommendation and thank you.

reviews.author: Mark Alexandridis
reviews.text: We have used M&R extensively over the last decade both inside and outside.They do an impeccable job prepping, painting, and clean-up. Very reliable, friendly, and prompt. True professionals.

reviews.author: Josette Mayes
reviews.text: Marcos is very professional along with his crew. The workmanship is by far the best. My home look's like a brand new home.

reviews.author: Paula Egitto
reviews.text: I’m impressed by the work they did in my house. They are super respectful and treat your home like theirs. Very detailed oriented and extremely clean, will definitely hire them for future jobs. Thanks!!

reviews.author: Willard Shelly
reviews.text: Been in the construction business for 50 years. These guys have learned their craft well. Good painters know their stuff! Won’t use anyone else as long as they stay true to their principals. I wish them nothing but great success going forward

reviews.author: Sandy Reyes
reviews.text: Best quality company! They work is very detailed and careful very different and focused on quality, I totally recommend them.

reviews.author: Michelle O’Connor
reviews.text: They did a amazing job painting our cabinets! Very professional and I would recommend them to anyone!

reviews.author: Edward Groth
reviews.text: Very thorough and meticulous. Starting with power washing, then sanding and scraping, priming (oil based), painting, caulking. Very pleased.

reviews.author: Em Dav
reviews.text: We had M&R repair and repaint our primary bedroom and bath. They did a meticulous job prepping and painting. Our house is 34 years old, they found and repaired sheetrock irregularities only I had seen with previous paint jobs. We highly recommend them! They were also extremely organized, came exactly when they said they would and did what they said they would.
